column2:
baby(n.)嬰兒、寶寶
(無詞性變化)
baby girl 女嬰
have a baby 生小孩
The baby is sleeping in her room.
(寶寶正在她的房間裡睡覺。)
My aunt just had a baby boy.
(我阿姨剛生了一個男寶寶。)

back(adv./n./v./adj.)向後、回原處、背部、支持
backward(adv.)向後地
come back 回來
back door 後門
Please come back before dinner.
(請在晚餐前回來。)
My back hurts after the long run.
(長跑之後我的背很痛。)

bad(adj.)壞的、不好的、嚴重的
badly(adv.)嚴重地、很差地
bad news 壞消息
bad habit 壞習慣
I have some bad news for you.
(我有一些壞消息要告訴你。)
Eating late at night is a bad habit.
(深夜吃東西是個壞習慣。)

bag(n.)袋子、包包
(無詞性變化)
school bag 書包
plastic bag 塑膠袋
She put her books in her school bag.
(她把書放進書包裡。)
Please bring your own bag to the store.
(請自備袋子到商店。)

ball(n./v.)球、舞會、把…捏成球狀
(無詞性變化)
play ball 打球
kick the ball 踢球
The boys are playing ball in the park.
(男孩們正在公園裡打球。)
He kicked the ball into the goal.
(他把球踢進球門。)

banana(n.)香蕉
(無詞性變化)
banana peel 香蕉皮
a bunch of bananas 一串香蕉
I eat a banana every morning.
(我每天早上吃一根香蕉。)
Mom bought a bunch of bananas at the market.
(媽媽在市場買了一串香蕉。)

band(n.)樂團、帶子、一群
(無詞性變化)
rock band 搖滾樂團
rubber band 橡皮筋
My brother plays the drums in a band.
(我哥哥在樂團裡打鼓。)
She tied her hair with a rubber band.
(她用橡皮筋把頭髮綁起來。)

bank(n./v.)銀行、河岸、存錢
banker(n.)銀行家
bank account 銀行帳戶
river bank 河岸
My dad works at a bank downtown.
(我爸爸在市中心的一家銀行工作。)
We sat on the river bank and talked.
(我們坐在河岸邊聊天。)

baseball(n.)棒球
(無詞性變化)
baseball game 棒球比賽
baseball player 棒球選手
We watched a baseball game on Sunday.
(我們星期天看了一場棒球賽。)
He wants to be a baseball player.
(他想成為一名棒球選手。)

basket(n.)籃子、(籃球的)籃框
(無詞性變化)
shopping basket 購物籃
a basket of fruit 一籃水果
She carried a basket of apples.
(她提著一籃蘋果。)
Put the toys back in the basket.
(把玩具放回籃子裡。)

basketball(n.)籃球
(無詞性變化)
play basketball 打籃球
basketball court 籃球場
We play basketball after school.
(我們放學後打籃球。)
The basketball court is full of students.
(籃球場上滿是學生。)

bat(n./v.)球棒、蝙蝠、用球棒擊球
(無詞性變化)
baseball bat 棒球棒
at bat 輪到打擊
He hit the ball with a wooden bat.
(他用木製球棒擊球。)
Bats usually come out at night.
(蝙蝠通常在晚上出沒。)

bath(n.)洗澡、浴缸
bathe(v.)洗澡、沐浴
take a bath 洗澡
bath towel 浴巾
I take a bath every night.
(我每天晚上洗澡。)
The baby enjoys a warm bath.
(寶寶喜歡洗溫水澡。)

bathroom(n.)浴室、廁所
(無詞性變化)
go to the bathroom 上廁所
clean the bathroom 打掃浴室
May I go to the bathroom?
(我可以去上廁所嗎？)
It is my turn to clean the bathroom.
(輪到我打掃浴室了。)

be(v./aux.)是、在、存在
being(n.)存在、生物
be late 遲到
be careful 小心
Please be careful when you cross the street.
(過馬路時請小心。)
Don't be late for school again.
(上學不要再遲到了。)

beach(n./v.)海灘、使(船)擱淺
(無詞性變化)
sandy beach 沙灘
on the beach 在海灘上
We played on the beach all day.
(我們整天都在海灘上玩。)
Kenting has many beautiful beaches.
(墾丁有許多美麗的海灘。)

bean(n.)豆子
(無詞性變化)
green bean 四季豆
red bean 紅豆
Grandma makes red bean soup in winter.
(奶奶冬天會煮紅豆湯。)
I don't like green beans very much.
(我不太喜歡四季豆。)

bear(v./n.)忍受、承擔、熊
bearable(adj.)可忍受的
can't bear 無法忍受
polar bear 北極熊
I can't bear the noise anymore.
(我再也受不了這個噪音了。)
We saw a big brown bear at the zoo.
(我們在動物園看到一隻大棕熊。)

beautiful(adj.)美麗的、漂亮的
beauty(n.)美、美人
beautifully(adv.)美麗地
beautiful view 美麗的景色
beautiful day 美好的一天
What a beautiful day it is today!
(今天天氣真好！)
The view from the mountain is beautiful.
(從山上看的景色很美。)

because(conj.)因為
(無詞性變化)
because of 由於
just because 只因為
I stayed home because I was sick.
(我因為生病待在家裡。)
The game was canceled because of the rain.
(比賽因為下雨而取消了。)

become(v.)變成、成為
(無詞性變化)
become friends 成為朋友
become famous 成名
She wants to become a doctor.
(她想成為醫生。)
We became good friends last year.
(我們去年成了好朋友。)

bed(n.)床
(無詞性變化)
go to bed 上床睡覺
make the bed 整理床鋪
I usually go to bed at eleven.
(我通常十一點上床睡覺。)
Please make your bed every morning.
(請每天早上整理床鋪。)

bedroom(n.)臥室
(無詞性變化)
master bedroom 主臥室
bedroom window 臥室窗戶
My bedroom is on the second floor.
(我的臥室在二樓。)
She is cleaning her bedroom now.
(她現在正在打掃臥室。)

bee(n.)蜜蜂
(無詞性變化)
busy as a bee 非常忙碌
bee sting 蜂螫
A bee is flying around the flowers.
(一隻蜜蜂在花朵周圍飛舞。)
Bees make honey for us.
(蜜蜂為我們製造蜂蜜。)

beef(n.)牛肉
(無詞性變化)
beef noodles 牛肉麵
ground beef 絞牛肉
Beef noodles are popular in Taiwan.
(牛肉麵在台灣很受歡迎。)
I don't eat beef or pork.
(我不吃牛肉也不吃豬肉。)

before(prep./conj./adv.)在…之前、以前
(無詞性變化)
before long 不久之後
the day before 前一天
Wash your hands before you eat.
(吃東西前要洗手。)
I have seen this movie before.
(我以前看過這部電影。)

begin(v.)開始
beginning(n.)開始、起點
beginner(n.)初學者
begin with 以…開始
at the beginning 一開始
Class begins at eight o'clock.
(八點開始上課。)
It began to rain in the afternoon.
(下午開始下雨了。)

behind(prep./adv.)在…後面、落後
(無詞性變化)
behind the door 在門後
fall behind 落後
The cat is hiding behind the sofa.
(貓躲在沙發後面。)
Don't fall behind in your studies.
(課業不要落後。)

believe(v.)相信、認為
belief(n.)信念、相信
believe in 信任、相信…存在
hard to believe 難以置信
I believe you can do it.
(我相信你做得到。)
It's hard to believe he is only ten.
(很難相信他只有十歲。)

bell(n.)鈴、鐘
(無詞性變化)
ring the bell 按鈴、敲鐘
school bell 學校鐘聲
The school bell rang at noon.
(中午學校鐘聲響了。)
Please ring the bell at the door.
(請按門口的電鈴。)

belong(v.)屬於
belongings(n.)財物、隨身物品
belong to 屬於
belong together 是一對、很相配
This book belongs to Amy.
(這本書是艾咪的。)
Do these shoes belong to you?
(這雙鞋是你的嗎？)

below(adv./prep.)在下方、低於
(無詞性變化)
below zero 零度以下
see below 見下文
The temperature fell below zero last night.
(昨晚氣溫降到零度以下。)
Write your name in the box below.
(把你的名字寫在下面的格子裡。)

belt(n./v.)皮帶、腰帶、用帶子繫
(無詞性變化)
seat belt 安全帶
leather belt 皮帶
Please fasten your seat belt.
(請繫好安全帶。)
He wears a black leather belt.
(他繫著一條黑色皮帶。)

bench(n.)長椅、長凳
(無詞性變化)
park bench 公園長椅
sit on a bench 坐在長椅上
An old man is sitting on the bench.
(一位老先生坐在長椅上。)
We ate lunch on a park bench.
(我們在公園長椅上吃午餐。)

beside(prep.)在…旁邊
(無詞性變化)
beside the window 在窗邊
sit beside 坐在…旁邊
Come and sit beside me.
(過來坐在我旁邊。)
There is a lamp beside the bed.
(床邊有一盞檯燈。)

best(adj./adv./v./n.)最好的、最好地、打敗、最佳
(無詞性變化)
best friend 最好的朋友
do one's best 盡力
Tom is my best friend.
(湯姆是我最好的朋友。)
Just do your best on the test.
(考試時盡力就好。)

between(prep./adv.)在…之間
(無詞性變化)
between A and B 在A和B之間
in between 在中間
The bank is between the school and the park.
(銀行位於學校和公園之間。)
Don't eat between meals.
(兩餐之間不要吃東西。)

bicycle(n.)腳踏車、自行車
bike(n.)腳踏車(口語)
ride a bicycle 騎腳踏車
bike lane 自行車道
I ride my bicycle to school.
(我騎腳踏車上學。)
Let's go for a bike ride this weekend.
(這個週末我們去騎腳踏車吧。)

big(adj.)大的、重要的
(無詞性變化)
big city 大城市
big deal 了不起的事
Taipei is a big city.
(台北是個大城市。)
Don't worry, it's no big deal.
(別擔心，這沒什麼大不了。)

bird(n.)鳥
(無詞性變化)
early bird 早起的人
bird watching 賞鳥
The birds are singing in the tree.
(鳥兒在樹上唱歌。)
The early bird catches the worm.
(早起的鳥兒有蟲吃。)

bite(n./v.)咬、一口、叮咬
(無詞性變化)
take a bite 咬一口
mosquito bite 蚊子叮咬
Can I take a bite of your apple?
(我可以咬一口你的蘋果嗎？)
The dog bit my leg.
(那隻狗咬了我的腿。)

black(adj./n.)黑色的、黑色
blacken(v.)使變黑
black coffee 黑咖啡
black and white 黑白的
He drinks black coffee every morning.
(他每天早上喝黑咖啡。)
She is wearing a black dress.
(她穿著一件黑色洋裝。)

blind(adj./v.)瞎的、盲目的、使失明
blindness(n.)失明
blind person 盲人
go blind 失明
The blind man walks with a dog.
(那位盲人由狗陪著走路。)
The bright light blinded me for a moment.
(強光讓我一時看不見。)

block(n./v.)街區、塊、阻擋
(無詞性變化)
two blocks away 兩個街區遠
block the road 擋住道路
The store is two blocks away.
(那家店在兩個街區外。)
A big tree blocked the road.
(一棵大樹擋住了道路。)

blow(v.)吹、颳(風)、吹氣
(無詞性變化)
blow out 吹熄
blow one's nose 擤鼻涕
Make a wish and blow out the candles.
(許個願然後吹熄蠟燭。)
The wind is blowing hard today.
(今天風颳得很大。)

blue(adj./n.)藍色的、憂鬱的、藍色
(無詞性變化)
blue sky 藍天
feel blue 心情低落
The sky is blue and clear today.
(今天天空湛藍晴朗。)
She feels blue on rainy days.
(她在雨天會心情低落。)

boat(n.)船、小船
(無詞性變化)
by boat 搭船
fishing boat 漁船
We went to the island by boat.
(我們搭船去那座島。)
Many fishing boats are in the harbor.
(港口裡有許多漁船。)

body(n.)身體、主體
(無詞性變化)
human body 人體
body language 肢體語言
Exercise is good for your body.
(運動對身體有益。)
Body language can show how you feel.
(肢體語言能表現你的感受。)

book(n./v.)書、預訂
booking(n.)預訂
read a book 看書
book a table 訂位
I read a book before bed.
(我睡前會看書。)
Let's book a table for dinner.
(我們預訂晚餐的位子吧。)

bored(adj.)感到無聊的
bore(v.)使厭煩
boredom(n.)無聊
get bored 覺得無聊
bored with 對…感到厭煩
I get bored when I stay home.
(待在家裡我會覺得無聊。)
The kids were bored with the long movie.
(孩子們對那部冗長的電影感到厭煩。)

boring(adj.)無聊的、乏味的
bore(v.)使厭煩
boring class 無聊的課
boring job 乏味的工作
This movie is so boring.
(這部電影好無聊。)
He thinks history class is boring.
(他覺得歷史課很無聊。)

born(adj.)出生的、天生的
bear(v.)生(小孩)
be born 出生
born in 在…出生
I was born in Taipei.
(我在台北出生。)
She is a born singer.
(她是天生的歌手。)

borrow(v.)借入、向…借
borrower(n.)借用者
borrow money 借錢
borrow from 向…借
Can I borrow your pen?
(我可以借你的筆嗎？)
I borrowed two books from the library.
(我向圖書館借了兩本書。)

boss(n./v.)老闆、上司、指揮
bossy(adj.)愛指使人的
my boss 我的老闆
boss around 對人頤指氣使
My boss is very kind to us.
(我的老闆對我們很好。)
Stop bossing your little sister around.
(不要再對你妹妹頤指氣使了。)

both(pron./adv./adj.)兩者、兩個都
(無詞性變化)
both A and B 兩者都…
both of us 我們兩個
Both of my parents are teachers.
(我的父母都是老師。)
She can speak both English and Japanese.
(她會說英文和日文。)

bottle(n./v.)瓶子、裝瓶
(無詞性變化)
water bottle 水瓶
a bottle of milk 一瓶牛奶
I bring a water bottle to school.
(我帶水瓶去學校。)
Please buy a bottle of milk.
(請買一瓶牛奶。)

bottom(n./adj./v.)底部、最下面的、降到最低點
(無詞性變化)
at the bottom of 在…的底部
from the bottom of my heart 打從心底
The keys are at the bottom of my bag.
(鑰匙在我包包的底部。)
Thank you from the bottom of my heart.
(打從心底感謝你。)

bow(n./v.)鞠躬、弓、蝴蝶結
(無詞性變化)
bow to 向…鞠躬
bow and arrow 弓箭
The students bowed to the teacher.
(學生們向老師鞠躬。)
She tied a pink bow in her hair.
(她在頭髮上繫了一個粉紅色蝴蝶結。)

bowl(n.)碗
(無詞性變化)
a bowl of rice 一碗飯
soup bowl 湯碗
I ate two bowls of rice tonight.
(我今晚吃了兩碗飯。)
Please wash the bowls after dinner.
(晚餐後請洗碗。)

box(n./v.)盒子、箱子、拳擊、裝箱
boxing(n.)拳擊
lunch box 便當盒
a box of 一盒…
He opened the box with a smile.
(他微笑著打開盒子。)
Mom put my lunch box in my bag.
(媽媽把我的便當盒放進包包。)

boy(n.)男孩
boyhood(n.)少年時期
little boy 小男孩
boy scout 童子軍
The little boy is crying.
(那個小男孩在哭。)
There are twenty boys in our class.
(我們班上有二十個男生。)

brave(adj.)勇敢的
bravery(n.)勇敢
bravely(adv.)勇敢地
brave act 勇敢的行為
be brave 勇敢一點
The brave boy saved his friend.
(那個勇敢的男孩救了他的朋友。)
Be brave and try again.
(勇敢一點，再試一次。)

bread(n.)麵包
(無詞性變化)
a slice of bread 一片麵包
fresh bread 新鮮麵包
I had bread and milk for breakfast.
(我早餐吃了麵包配牛奶。)
The bakery sells fresh bread.
(那間麵包店賣新鮮麵包。)

break(n./v.)休息、打破、弄壞
broken(adj.)破的、壞掉的
take a break 休息一下
break the rules 違反規則
Let's take a break.
(我們休息一下吧。)
Who broke the window?
(誰打破了窗戶？)

breakfast(n./v.)早餐、吃早餐
(無詞性變化)
have breakfast 吃早餐
breakfast shop 早餐店
I have breakfast at seven.
(我七點吃早餐。)
There is a breakfast shop near my house.
(我家附近有一間早餐店。)

bridge(n./v.)橋、橋梁、彌合
(無詞性變化)
cross the bridge 過橋
build a bridge 建造橋梁
We walked across the bridge.
(我們走過那座橋。)
This bridge is very old.
(這座橋非常古老。)

bright(adj./adv.)明亮的、聰明的、光明的
brightly(adv.)明亮地
brighten(v.)使明亮
bright future 光明的未來
bright student 聰明的學生
The room is bright and clean.
(這個房間明亮又乾淨。)
She is a bright student.
(她是個聰明的學生。)

bring(v.)帶來、拿來
(無詞性變化)
bring back 帶回來
bring up 養育、提出
Don't forget to bring your umbrella.
(別忘了帶雨傘。)
Can you bring me a glass of water?
(你可以幫我拿一杯水來嗎？)

brother(n.)兄弟、哥哥、弟弟
brotherhood(n.)兄弟情誼
older brother 哥哥
younger brother 弟弟
My older brother is in college.
(我哥哥在讀大學。)
I have one younger brother.
(我有一個弟弟。)

brown(adj./v./n.)棕色的、煎成褐色、棕色
(無詞性變化)
brown hair 棕髮
brown sugar 紅糖、黑糖
She has long brown hair.
(她有一頭棕色長髮。)
Brown the onions in a pan first.
(先把洋蔥放在鍋裡煎到金黃。)

bug(n./v.)蟲子、程式錯誤、煩擾
(無詞性變化)
fix a bug 修正程式錯誤
stomach bug 腸胃型感冒
There is a bug on the wall.
(牆上有一隻蟲。)
Stop bugging me while I study.
(我讀書時別來煩我。)

build(v.)建造、建立
building(n.)建築物
builder(n.)建築工人
build a house 蓋房子
build up 逐步建立
They are building a new library.
(他們正在蓋一座新圖書館。)
Reading helps you build your vocabulary.
(閱讀能幫助你累積字彙。)

bus(n.)公車、巴士
(無詞性變化)
bus stop 公車站
take a bus 搭公車
I take the bus to school.
(我搭公車上學。)
Let's wait at the bus stop.
(我們在公車站等吧。)

business(n.)生意、商業、事務
businessman(n.)商人
on business 出差
none of your business 不關你的事
My father went to Japan on business.
(我爸爸去日本出差。)
She runs a small business.
(她經營一家小公司。)

busy(adj.)忙碌的、熱鬧的、(電話)占線的
